plain_statement: Any incidence in which no two points share two lines: every AND/OR circuit with each gate reading exactly two earlier wires that computes its incidence function has one of the same kind, with the same function and no more gates, in two levels, in which every AND gate reads a line-side wire first and a point-side wire second (each side its inputs and ORs of its own wires).
